arguments.value: Jonathan Allen Kobes was born in Sioux City, Iowa, in 1974. He has served as a judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit since 2018, after being nominated by President Donald J. Trump and confirmed by the Senate. Kobes earned his B.A. from Dordt College in 1996 and his J.D. from Harvard Law School in 2000. Earlier in his career, he clerked for Judge Roger L. Wollman on the Eighth Circuit, served as an honors attorney at the Central Intelligence Agency, and worked as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of South Dakota. He later practiced in Sioux Falls, held senior legal and compliance roles at POET, DuPont Pioneer, and Raven Industries, and served in various senior legal and advisory positions in the office of U.S. Senator M. Michael Rounds before joining the federal bench.
